notes.title: A Selection of Changes
notes.notes:
We've added in a new way to play Fortune & Gloria with a selection screen that allows you to choose the player(s), enemies and environment, while still giving the option for random missions.

We've also made a bunch of fixes and improvements to remove some annoyances and enhance the gameplay experience.

The changes included in this update are:
- New level selection screen so you can choose your player(s), enemy and environment, which makes it easier to complete achievements
- Health packs are no longer hit/destroyed by bullets
- Explosions are 50% bigger, damaging more of their surroundings
- Adjusted the default zoom to show (can still be adjusted with - and +)
- Fixed animation error when crouching using a controller
- Tweaked jump to make controls feel tighter
- Footsteps and some other sounds stopped when paused

We hope you enjoy the changes we've made

notes.title: Quality of CoOp Life Update
notes.notes:
We've made a few quality of life changes that should improve the gameplay experience, especially for co-op, and overall make Fortune & Gloria more fun to play.

The main changes include:
- Reduced loading times for levels
- Reduced damage from explosions and gas clouds
- Increased chance of health packs dropping
- Additional visual and audio indicator when enemies are killed
- Camera follows lead player better in CoOp
- Player in CoOp who goes off-screen will be teleported near lead player
- Increased chance of attack helicopter or tank appearing in levels

There was also an engine update and a few settings tweaks.

If you've not yet purchased Fortune & Gloria, we will be putting the game on sale soon, so keep an eye out for that.

notes.title: Update:Control
notes.notes:
We've just released an update to bring a few improvements and make playing Fortune & Gloria a more enjoyable experience.

Some of the changes include:
- Control scheme changed to be more intuitive
- Tighter and more responsive controls
- Immunity from spikes for 2sec after initial damage
- Adjusted difficulty to make things a little easier

We hope you enjoy this update.

notes.title: Rapid Fire Update and New Demo
notes.notes:
We've got another update for you, just small one in terms of changes but big in terms of impact.

- Fire rate increased to make missions easier (and more fun!)
- Explosion screenshake added (because it's cool)
- Fixed game not pausing when using Steam overaly (because that sucked)
- Changed health and grenade icons to make it easier to keep track of things
- Updated environment and enemy selection to avoid see the same ones too often

We've also updated the demo version to include all the recent changes, so that it gives a more accurate impression of the full game.

notes.title: Working on a big update
notes.notes:
We're working on a big update to Fortune & Gloria based on player and reviewer feedback, fixing a few small issues, adding more content, bringing in some quality of life improvements and increasing the fun factor.

Some of the changes that will be included in the update are:
- Solo and CoOp modes split (can still play CoOp with AI ally)
- New end condition: beat the boss, board the helicopter
- New enemy units: Attack Helicopter and Tank
- All enemies unlocked at start for more variety
- Improved enemy AI responsiveness
- Balanced difficulty levels
- Enhanced visual feedback for killing enemies and on victory
- Updated sound system for more immersive soundscape
- Increased level variablility for more replayability
- Gamepad controls more responsive
- Windowed mode: press Alt+Enter or F11 to toggle

The update should be out before the end of the month, and will likely be followed with a sale in early October.

We're also releasing a small pirate-themed game next week called [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/928940/]Pirate Island Rescue[/url], and some of the improvements in Fortune & Gloria came from making that game.

notes.title: The Release Date
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce that Fortune & Gloria will be released 24 July 2018.

We've completed Steam integration so that the game works with the Steam Overlay and we've added in the Achievements.

All that's left is just to do some final testing and get the word out. Make sure to Wishlist the game so you get notified when it releases, and please share with your friends.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/881060/Fortune__Gloria/

If you can't wait to play the game, don't forget to check out the Demo, just look for the Download Demo button on the store page or click the link below.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/900250/
